text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from running errands with 
Calstone Light O—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. My stomach is speaking to me. It 
says it is empty."
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'm hungry too, so want to grab a 
bite before heading home?

Right. I'm hungry too, so want to grab a 
bite before heading home?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Then—Ah! There's a "Straight Wire Hall"! 
Let's go, Trainer, right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Straight Wire Emporium," the place where 
I was once handed a clothespin and forced 
to fish for walleye pollock... 
...Honestly, it terrifies me. Bracing 
myself, I entered the shop.

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
…………――Now then, let us begin with today's 
confessions. Those who have regrets, pray 
to the donburi.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Tracksuit
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to go first. —It happened just 
two days ago. I... ate an Ultra Giga 
Burger Set.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sweats
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? The Ultra Giga Burger Combo?!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
FOOOOOOOL!! That single set has an entire 
day's worth of calories!! Don't just 
casually devour that outside of a cheat 
day!!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, today we're reviewing 
nutrition! Hammer the ingredients 
essential for running back into your 
heads!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Trainer, I think we might have 
stumbled into somewhere bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the store was packed with 
Umamusume. Completely surrounded on all 
sides, it looked impossible to make it to 
the exit...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—They do say, "When in Rome, do as the 
Romans do." Since you're here, why not 
take it easy for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Stego-san. Do you know anything about 
this bizarre gathering?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, I just came here to eat some ramen. 
Looked like you guys were having fun, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think so? I don't understand 
it at all. It's bizarre, creepy, and 
abnormal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Shopkeeper, please explain yourself 
properly! Otherwise, I will report this to 
the proper authorities!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a newcomer to the seminar? Then it's 
only natural you'd wonder. The truth is—I 
used to be a racing Umamusume myself.

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Using that experience, I'm holding a 
seminar on nutritional science—called 
'Learning Maintenance.'

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Short for 'Learning & Maintenance', huh. 
Haha, what do you know. It's just an 
ordinary seminar."

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
You might've already noticed after eating 
our ramen, but—

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
See, my ramen had fish cakes in it— packed 
with ingredients to build the fast-twitch 
muscle needed for sprints, right? That was 
all part of the lesson.
choice_data_list: Ah, come to think of it...!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
âRamen is a complete, perfect 
nutritional meal, you see.

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Protein, minerals, fats, carbohydrates... 
Eat ramen, and everything is in 
balance—everything goes well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. That makes sense. Actually, 
I've been thinking the same thing 
recently.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Top speed is always a battle against 
one's limits. —The closer you get to the 
light, the more your body burns and gets 
worn down.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It might be fine for now— but if all you 
do is burn through your energy, you will 
break down someday.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That is why, going forward, you will need 
a body that can endure that speed. So that 
the speed does not tear you apart.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In that respect, the ramen here is 
fantastic. I feel like it's doing wonders 
for my fast-twitch muscles, and above all, 
it fills me with energy.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—So that I can remain the fastest. —So 
that I can remain a light that never burns 
out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I was amazed. To think 
she had thought this far ahead. Not just 
for right now, but to ensure she remains 
the fastest in the future, too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha. ...You look surprised.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—They just grow on their own, you know. 
Far surpassing anything we could have ever 
predicted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Calstone Light O listened 
intently with a positive attitude— making 
me feel glad that I had come.
